papers.title_en: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
papers.authors: Guanhua Zhu, Hanwen Li, Zhi Wei, Mengnan Du, Chenxi Yuan
papers.evidence: 具备检索、去重与维护的结构化记忆
papers.tldr: LLM智能体常把轨迹、工作流和推理项混存于单层记忆，难以遗忘去重且易负迁移。STRATA将经验组织为原子技能/代码、任务工作流、泛化元框架三层类型化图，并用多维相似度、类型化反思、社区检测、压力触发垃圾回收与对比边自我维护。四个交互基准、两个冻结骨干和七个基线中，它取得最佳平均分，同时延迟和环境步数最低，注入记忆行数比最耗上下文基线少44%。该工作表明结构化、结果接地且可自维护的记忆能缓解单层记忆扩展退化与负迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve at test time by accumulating experience: retrieving relevant memories before acting and writing new lessons back afterwards. Yet most are single-level: trajectories, distilled workflows and reasoning items all land in one undifferentiated pool indexed by embedding similarity, with no typed abstraction hierarchy. They never forget or deduplicate, and are prone to negative transfer, where a superficially similar but directionally opposite experience is recalled and its concrete steps are copied verbatim, actively harming the agent. We introduce STRATA, a structured, outcome-grounded, self-maintaining memory that organizes experience into a three-layer graph of atomic skills and code snippets, task workflows and generalized meta-frameworks, connected by typed edges. STRATA maintains itself through five mechanisms sharing one similarity geometry: a multi-dimensional similarity that scores retrieval by operation and target; a typed reflector crystallizing procedures from successes and pitfalls from failures; community detection that induces meta-frameworks; pressure-triggered garbage collection with articulation-point protection; and contrast edges that flag confusable, direction-opposite experiences. Across four interactive benchmarks (AppWorld, WebArena, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), two frozen backbones and seven baselines, STRATA attains the best average score while simultaneously using the lowest latency and fewest environment steps of any memory-augmented method, and 44% fewer lines of injected memory than the most context-hungry baseline. We isolate two failure modes of prior memories: single-level memory degrades sharply as the task set grows, and single-level concrete memories suffer catastrophic negative transfer, which contrast edges repair, lifting ScienceWorld from 78.7 to 96.7 within the same system.

papers.title_en: RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Linyao Zheng, Xuhang Shi, Zhifang Mao, Xiuquan Hou, Sai Zhou
papers.evidence: 迭代检索增强生成，从检索段落重构跨证据关系
papers.tldr: 迭代RAG在新增证据时难以重建跨段落实体对应与推理依赖。RCER从累积源段落中重构跨证据关系：轮间关系证据获取驱动动态问题分解与迭代检索，推理上下文重建联合选择互补段落并推导跨证据推断，组合推理据此建立实体对应并合成关系。三个多跳QA基准上平均超最佳基线2.83 EM和3.06 F1，叙事与隐式推理任务亦更优。该工作表明显式重构跨证据关系能提升迭代检索增强生成。
papers.abstract_en: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.

papers.title_en: TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Pengfeng Song, Yunkai Zhuang, Liye Shi
papers.evidence: 面向智能体的版本化事实记忆与检索
papers.tldr: 针对对话中事实反复更新、旧值仍可能相关的问题，TEM提出免训练记忆框架，将事实存为带来源的版本化记录。检索时按来源顺序排列相关版本，并在证据中标注历史状态后交给答案模型。在420题、60角色评测中，关键实体命中率达75.71%–97.62%，历史居住子集达96.67%–100.00%。证据仅94–118 token，较会话感知RAG少48.75%–56.73%，并在LoCoMo上领先基线。
papers.abstract_en: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Chloe Su, Jiahan Li, Zhenting Qi, Chaoran Cheng, Haoyu Chen, Sejoon Jun, Weirui Ye, Yilun Du
papers.evidence: 含情景、空间、语义与工作记忆的多模态文件系统记忆架构
papers.tldr: 长时程具身智能体需要复用经验，但保留全历史难检索，摘要压缩又会丢失视觉与空间细节。MFM 用多模态文件系统组织情景、空间、语义、程序与工作记忆，并以可检索文本记录连接原始多模态片段。智能体可凭上下文线索找回经历并回看原始观察，通过巩固把经验转成知识与可复用流程。在 Minecraft 与电脑操作任务上，MFM 在三个基座模型上提升表现，GPT-6-Astra 完成从零挖钻石，Ender Dragon 达 16/24 里程碑。
papers.abstract_en: Agents operating over long horizons need an effective memory that allows them to reuse their experience throughout long interactions. If the entire history of an interaction is retained, it becomes difficult to find the relevant experience, while compressing it into summaries may result in the loss of visual and spatial details that are required later on. We present \textbf{MFM}, a multimodal filesystem memory architecture that keeps complementary types of agent memory. \textbf{Episodic memory} stores the observations, actions, and outcomes, and \textbf{spatial memory} associates experiences with locations. \textbf{Semantic and procedural memory} build up general knowledge and reusable methods of acting, and \textbf{working memory} holds the current plans. MFM makes use of searchable textual records to connect these different representations to the underlying multimodal episodes. The agents are able to find previous experiences by means of contextual cues and to examine the original observations in order to recover details that are missing from their textual descriptions. Through consolidation, the agents convert experience into higher-level knowledge and procedures while still keeping references to the original episodes. In the case of long-horizon Minecraft and computer-use tasks, MFM leads to improved performance with three base models. With GPT-6-Astra, MFM completes \emph{Mine Diamond from Scratch} and reaches 16 out of 24 milestones on the \emph{Ender Dragon} task, as against 12.7 for the best baseline. On CUABench-KiCad it attains a mean reward of 0.440, as compared to 0.400 for the best baseline and 0.267 in the case of no persistent memory.

papers.title_en: Let Them Sleep: Recursive Self-Pruning Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Kargi Chauhan, Sadiba Nusrat Nur, Pratibha Revankar, Kyle Montgomery, Chenguang Wang
papers.evidence: 通过睡眠、规则蒸馏与片段剪枝实现记忆巩固
papers.tldr: 长时运行的LLM智能体常因记忆库累积过时事实与失败轨迹而反复犯错。RSPM借鉴生物睡眠机制，在间隔期聚类近期失败、蒸馏短规则并删除原始片段，规则会衰减并可在多情境复现后升格为通用规则。在三类差异很大的任务上分别提升9.1、11.9和7.6分，同时重试循环约减少93%、存储条目约减少30%。这表明“知道该忘记什么”可能是智能体记忆的通用能力。
papers.abstract_en: Agents that run for a long time have a memory problem, and it is not the one most systems optimize for. Storing every trace and retrieving the nearest neighbors works early and quietly stops working later: the store fills up with failures the agent then repeats, and with facts that were true fifty turns ago. RSPM (Recursive Self-Pruning Memory) borrows the fix biology already found. At intervals the agent sleeps. It clusters its recent failures, distills each cluster into a short rule, and deletes the raw episodes it just learned from. Rules decay unless something reinforces them, and rules that recur across many contexts get promoted into general ones. We tested this on three settings with little in common: a difficulty-calibrated SWE-bench simulation, temporal consistency across 12 conversational benchmarks, and long-horizon QA on LoCoMo-10. All three improve, by 9.1, 11.9, and 7.6 points respectively. More interestingly, the two studies that instrument the store itself converge on nearly the same operating point without being tuned toward it: roughly 93% fewer retry loops and roughly 30% fewer stored entries. That hints that knowing what to forget is a general property of agent memory rather than a benchmark-specific trick.

papers.title_en: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Mai Liu, He Sun, Siru Zhong, Kerun Chen, Hao Yan, Xiaohui Lv, Shuai Tao, Wulong Liu
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体的六层长期记忆框架
papers.tldr: 长时程具身智能体常受时序混乱、记录缺失失真和固定记忆规则反复出错困扰，存取成本也随历史增长。BetaMem 构建工作、空间、实体、情节、经验、程序六层可追溯记忆，用双层写入契约与强化学习保证记录可执行、完整且有来源。基于 Qwen3.5-9B，其在 M3-Bench-robot、LoCoMo、EM-EQA、EgoLifeQA 上分别达 48.08%、92.08%、72.6%、62.4%，契约通过率由 50.9% 升至 86.2%。该框架以失败驱动规则自改进和预算约束工具增强跨观测整合与长历史回忆。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.

papers.title_en: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
papers.authors: Debopriyo Banerjee, Owais Aijaz, Ahmer Tabassum, Zhuohan Xie, Preslav Nakov, Veselin Stoyanov
papers.evidence: 诊断RAG检索瓶颈并以行级引用评估长上下文问答的证据落地
papers.tldr: RAG依赖相似度分块检索，难以预判多事实问题所需全部段落，并丢失跨段落引用所需的文档级信息。作者提出证据生成EBG，要求答案附行级引用，并用Ans+Evid联合评估正确性与依据。在重构的多文档QA、合成两跳和10K-1M字符NoLiMa上测试13个模型，发现瓶颈在检索而非长上下文阅读，分块还破坏身份解析。该工作揭示仅看答案会漏掉的依据缺陷，并提供基准与代码。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models in external corpora, but its similarity-driven, chunked pipeline has structural blind spots: it cannot anticipate which passages a question requires and discards document-level context that resolves cross-passage references. We introduce evidence-based generation (EBG), requiring models to return an answer with line-level citations, and a joint Ans+Evid metric that scores correctness and grounding simultaneously. We reformulate two corpora into evidence-grounded multi-document QA benchmarks- MultiHop-RAG and QASPER-MP, a multi-paper adaptation of QASPER with realistic short paper cues, and pair them with a controlled synthetic two-hop haystack and an evidence-augmented NoLiMa spanning 10K-1M characters. Across ten proprietary frontier and three open-weight LLMs, EBG isolates two RAG limitations that long-context models avoid: similarity retrieval surfaces any relevant chunk far more reliably than all required chunks for multi-fact queries, and chunking destroys document meta-information needed to resolve identity-bearing queries. EBG also exposes grounding failures invisible to answer-only evaluation, including incomplete citations in two-needle settings and a widening gap between Ans and Ans+Evid when context contradicts parametric knowledge. Data and code are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/LC-EBG.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Hong Ting Tsang, Boyi Zhang, Haoyu Huang, Jiaxin Bai, Yufei Li, Yisen Gao, Zhongwei Xie, Hongyu Luo, Jeff Z. Pan, Yangqiu Song
papers.evidence: 面向对话智能体的全模态长期记忆基准
papers.tldr: 现有长期记忆基准多为文本加图像或仅给单一端到端分数，难以定位多模态证据在表示、检索、交付或阅读环节的损失。MOSAIC 构建覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频的923题基准，历史含11-24个会话，并配对冻结问题、阅读器、提示和预算的诊断协议，分别干预表示、检索与交付。结果显示表示损失依模态而异，金标证据下阅读残余仍占主导，拒答能力偏弱。该基准将全模态记忆评估从排行榜转为对写入、检索、交付和阅读失败的诊断。
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.

papers.title_en: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
papers.authors: Jian Zhong, Zeyu Liu, Pingchuan Cao, Rongduo Han, Shunye Tang, Guohuan Xie, Mingyuan Qin, Ran Ji, Xiao Liang, Wei Wang, Haining Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向长期对话智能体、受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架
papers.tldr: 长期对话代理既要稳定记忆以支撑个性化，又要适应用户真实变化，但现有系统难辨瞬态噪声与信念漂移。PreCoMem受预测编码启发，把记忆建模为置信加权信念，并用Effective Surprisal结合语义偏差与矛盾证据，在检索弥散时降权。双阈值门控将每轮映射为MAINTAIN、PROFILE、CORRECT三种确定性更新，PROFILE暂存低置信假设。在三个数据集取得SOTA，DiMoBench验证其适应非平稳漂移且不过度反应噪声，为自演化长期记忆提供新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and PersonaMem-v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem.

papers.title_en: Uni-Mem: Learning a Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Manager with Unified Online Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Zhiqian Xia, Jielong Tang, Ling-An Zeng, Shixiong Kai, Rong Yao, Hao Kong, Xiao Dong, Wei Wang, Mingxuan Yuan, Siyu Xia, Haifeng Xia
papers.evidence: 联合优化记忆构建与检索的可学习长期记忆管理器
papers.tldr: 长期智能体记忆的构建与检索仍多依赖预设流程或分阶段学习，难以端到端协同适应。Uni-Mem 以共享策略统一学习记忆构建与检索，并提出 Stage-Decoupled GRPO 交替优化两阶段、控制组内干扰，同时用 Event-Wise Credit Assignment 将反馈定位到事件并传播到具体操作。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上，它优于最强 RL 记忆方法。该工作验证了端到端在线 RL 联合学习统一记忆管理器的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. To this end, we propose Stage-Decoupled GRPO, which alternates construction and retrieval optimization while controlling variation from the other stage within each rollout group, yielding stage-specific learning signals. We further introduce Event-Wise Credit Assignment (ECA), which localizes feedback to responsible events and propagates event-level advantages to their constituent operations. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Uni-Mem outperforms the strongest RL-based memory, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning memory construction and retrieval via Stage-Decoupled GRPO and ECA.

papers.title_en: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
papers.authors: Zedong Peng
papers.evidence: 对智能体记忆系统存取长对话历史的实证比较
papers.tldr: 智能体记忆系统通常在提问前决定保留什么，而编码智能体保留原始历史并让模型自行搜索。论文在一个419轮、152问的LoCoMo对话上，比较四种记忆方法与三种编码智能体，并搭配三个模型记录成本。结果显示，设计记忆更像弱模型的昂贵补丁，Mem0仅在GPT-4o-mini上优于全上下文且构建成本更高。强模型下Pi以99%准确率、不到全上下文一半成本居成本-准确率前沿，说明记忆收益受写入模型上限约束。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.

papers.title_en: Parameters vs. Context: TRACE Fine-Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Zhengchen Huang, Yundong Sun, Minrui Song, Shuanglong Yao, Ye Liu, Ji Chen, Xing Wang
papers.evidence: 面向知识冲突与幻觉的鲁棒RAG微调框架
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成在外部知识与模型参数知识冲突时，可能盲从误导上下文或错误依赖参数知识，造成回答不可靠。TRACE通过多智能体辩论轨迹提取正确候选、错误候选和答案转移模式，提供细粒度知识源选择监督。它还用答案完整性正则强化答案尾部token并抑制过早终止，以减少空答和过短回答。多场景实验表明该方法能抵抗误导检索、减少不完整答案，并提升冲突鲁棒性与回答质量。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates knowledge obsolescence and factual hallucination in large language models by introducing external context. However, when retrieved knowledge conflicts with the model's internal parametric knowledge, the model may either blindly follow misleading context or incorrectly rely on parametric knowledge, leading to unreliable responses. To address this issue, this paper proposes TRACE (Debate-TRace and Answer-Completeness rEgularized fine-tuning), a robust fine-tuning framework for RAG under knowledge conflicts. First, we propose a fine-tuning method that leverages multi-agent debate traces to extract correct candidates, incorrect candidates, and answer-shift patterns, providing fine-grained supervision for reliable knowledge-source selection. In addition, we design an answer completeness regularization mechanism to alleviate empty, overly short, and prematurely terminated responses via answer-tail token reinforcement and premature termination suppression. The fine-tuning objective combines correct-answer supervision, incorrect-candidate suppression, answer-tail token reinforcement, and premature termination suppression, enabling the model to use reliable external context, resist misleading or irrelevant retrieved content, and fall back to parametric knowledge when retrieved evidence is unreliable. Experiments across multiple knowledge-conflict scenarios and datasets show that TRACE improves robustness against misleading retrieved knowledge and reduces incomplete answers. These results demonstrate that multi-agent debate traces and answer completeness regularization jointly enhance knowledge-source selection, conflict robustness, and answer quality in RAG models. Our code is available at https://github.com/PHD-lanyu/TRACE.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Governing Memory Validity in Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Wenjun Xiong, Shengtao Zhang, Shangding Gu, Bo Tang, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong, Ying Wen, Muning Wen
papers.evidence: TRACE治理共享状态变化后已检索的持久记忆是否仍可用于行动
papers.tldr: 多智能体长期协作中，持久记忆会因共享状态变化而失效，返回智能体不能仅凭检索正确就采取行动。TRACE 将重新入场视为记忆资格判定，无需训练，通过对照离开检查点与缺席期更新、处理显隐式失效，并仅在覆盖未结义务时释放有界 Return View。实验显示其能同时保持有效记忆并拒绝过期记忆，在 ManBench-Return 达 92.6-98.3% 有效信息可用率与 98.4-99.5% 无效信息拒绝率，STALE Type II 总体指标显著优于单策略基线。该工作为演化多智能体系统的记忆生命周期治理提供了可操作框架。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory lets language-model agents carry information across long-running collaborations, but leaves a lifecycle question open: what may a returning agent still act on once the shared state has changed? A memory can be correctly retrieved, relevant to the current task, and faithful to its source, and nonetheless be inadmissible for action: an itinerary saved before a pause still names the hotel the team has since replaced. We formalize this as temporal memory admission and present TRACE, a training-free layer that treats re-entry as an eligibility decision rather than a storage or retrieval operation, reconciling a departure checkpoint against absence-period updates, resolving explicit and implicit invalidation, and releasing a bounded Return View only when it covers the returning role's open obligations. We evaluate TRACE under three actor models on Memora, STALE Type II, and a derived ManBench-Return setting, each recast as return episodes: one agent departs, four teammates change the shared state, and the agent rejoins. What separates methods is not overall accuracy but whether one can retain valid memory and reject stale memory at once, and no single-policy baseline can: Restore (reinstate the departure checkpoint in full) admits stale state, Reset (start the return from an empty memory) discards valid state, each bottoming out at 0% on one of the two. TRACE is the only method high on both, reaching 92.6-98.3% valid-information availability with 98.4-99.5% invalid-information rejection on ManBench-Return, within 3.8 points of the best baseline's overall accuracy. On STALE Type II it improves Overall over the strongest comparison policy by 22.3 (Qwen), 18.5 (Gemini), and 27.5 (DeepSeek) points at roughly 2.3 times their tokens, while a write-time consolidation pipeline is more accurate still at 3.99 times TRACE's.

papers.title_en: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs
papers.authors: Abdelhak kelious
papers.evidence: 在法语PDF上评测五种RAG变体并评估页面级证据
papers.tldr: 研究面向法语PDF问答的页面感知RAG，要求同时评估答案与支撑页面。以BM25为基线，依次加入稠密检索、排名融合、重排序和查询分解，构建五种系统变体。在595道挑战题上，完整系统取得0.4450 MRR@10与0.4013 Recall@10，优于BM25的0.3430和0.2994；但稠密检索单独使用及简单融合反而不如BM25。结果表明，重排序和查询分解有效，页面选择准确性而非孤立语义检索是主要改进空间。
papers.abstract_en: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.

papers.title_en: BaRe-Mem: Bayesian Reliability Memory for Robust and Adaptive Agent Consultation
papers.authors: Peilin Feng, Zhengyang Huang, Soujanya Poria
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体咨询系统的在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆
papers.tldr: 多智能体咨询中，顾问能力因任务而异，误导信息可能让咨询反而不如自主推理。BaRe-Mem 用在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆，基于中心模型的内部信念表征估计顾问可靠性，并据历史交互持续更新。这些估计用于调节顾问回答的影响权重，并决定是咨询还是自主推理。在九个基准和六个中心模型上，它比辩论与多数投票更能抵抗误导信息。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent systems, reliable consultation is challenging because advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading information can make consultation worse than autonomous reasoning. We introduce BaRe-Mem, an online Bayesian reliability memory for multi-agent consultation. It estimates advisor reliability based on the central model's internal belief representations and updates these estimates from historical interactions. These estimates modulate the influence of advisor responses and guide the choice between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Across nine benchmarks and six central models, BaRe-Mem is more robust to misleading advisor information than debate and majority voting. On the more challenging tasks, it remains above autonomous reasoning across all tested misleading levels. Moreover, we extend the BaRe-Mem mechanism to worker allocation in agent teams. On the MuSiQue benchmark, BaRe-Mem improves task completion over routing by historical success counts and identifies capable workers earlier.

papers.title_en: Retrieve What Helps, Only When It Helps: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation
papers.authors: Shijun Li, Yang Liu, Najmeh Sadoughi, Dongmei Wang, Xinjie Li, Zhu Liu, Rohith Mysore Vijaya Kumar, Yuzong Liu
papers.evidence: 面向大模型流程的选择性检索增强策略
papers.tldr: 现有检索增强机器翻译对所有输入套用固定检索策略，忽视大模型参数知识已足够、外部证据仅对部分样本有益的事实。作者提出SRAT智能体强化学习框架，学习何时直接翻译或检索、检索什么及如何融合，并以最终译文质量优化检索器。在习语、知识密集和文档级翻译上，SRAT稳定优于从不检索和始终检索基线。该工作把检索视为可学习翻译动作而非固定预处理。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. To align evidence retrieval with downstream translation quality rather than simple semantic similarity, we further develop joint Plackett--Luce optimization and translation-quality contrastive training for retriever-training. Experiments on idiom, knowledge-intensive, and document-level translation with offline or online retrieval show that SRAT consistently outperforms never- and always-retrieve baselines, and quality-aligned retriever training provides further gains when similarity-based retrieval is insufficient. The results demonstrate the benefit of treating retrieval as a learnable translation action rather than fixed preprocessing.

papers.title_en: From Long Context to Selective Memory:A Survey of Memory-Centric Compression for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Chaogui Gou
papers.evidence: 综述将长上下文压缩重构为含智能体记忆的记忆管理问题
papers.tldr: 长上下文能力虽关键，但扩大窗口无法消除推理时的计算、存储与信息选择压力。本文把长上下文压缩重构为推理期内存管理问题，区分计算活跃与非活跃内存，并将写入、卸载、召回、注入、物化、驱逐、整合与遗忘建模为信息生命周期状态转移。作者提出统一预算成本模型，串联短期上下文压缩与长期记忆管理。核心挑战不只是缩减信息量，而是决定哪些信息、何时、以何种形式参与昂贵推理。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. We distinguish compute-active memory, which directly participates in model computation, from compute-inactive memory, which lies outside the computation path but can be stored, retrieved, updated, or forgotten, and we characterize offloaded KV caches, persistent prefix caches, and precomputed KV states as intermediate states on the activation path. On this basis, we formulate writing, offloading, recall, retrieval-and-injection, materialization, eviction, consolidation, and forgetting as state transitions within an information lifecycle, and introduce a budgeted cost model that places these operations in a single cost account. The resulting framework unifies short-term context compression, long-term memory management, and the transitions between them, and shows that the central challenge is not merely reducing information volume but deciding which information should participate in costly inference, when, and in what form. We further summarize evaluation dimensions, benchmark gaps, and open challenges, and argue that future research should move from static, pointwise compression toward dynamic, governable, lifecycle-aware memory management.

papers.title_en: An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory
papers.authors: Dohyun Lee, Minho Park, Jeonghoon Park, Dongyoon Hwang, Junha Hyung, Sungwon Hwang, Byungkun Lee, Jaegul Choo
papers.evidence: 面向机器人的程序化辅助记忆智能体框架
papers.tldr: 主动机器人需在用户开口前提供帮助，但仅靠常识推断意图易因个体差异造成误助。本文提出基于记忆的智能体框架：VLM任务预测器结合程序化辅助记忆PAM决定何时助、助什么，VLA执行器完成任务，反思VLM每日修订PAM。5天桌面辅助实验中，系统随经验累积持续提升，精度、召回和F1最高，首次触发延迟从第1天约5秒降至第5天1秒。该工作表明可反思的程序化记忆能让主动辅助更准更快并适应日常习惯变化。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive robots should anticipate user needs and provide assistance before being explicitly asked. A straightforward approach is to infer human intentions from commonsense knowledge, but the same observed behavior can imply different needs across users, potentially leading to unwanted assistance. We observe that everyday routines in the real world exhibit recurring patterns, so learning these patterns can reduce ambiguity in proactive decisions. Based on this, we propose a memory-based agentic framework in which a VLM task predictor reads a Procedural Assistance Memory (PAM) alongside the current observation to decide when to assist and what task to perform, and a VLA executor performs the predicted task. PAM is structured as a finite-state machine over activity phases, per-state assistance rules, and event-driven transitions; a reflection VLM revises PAM from each day's interaction trace without weight updates or retraining. In our 5-day desk-assistance evaluation, memory-free baselines remain conservative, with limited recall on proactive tasks. Our system improves consistently with accumulated experience, achieving the highest precision, recall, and F1 and reducing first-fire delay from approximately 5 seconds on Day 1 to 1 second by Day 5. Our approach also adapts to changes in the user's routine through continued memory reflection, recovering from memory--routine misalignment after a single memory update. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/PAM/

papers.title_en: Rethinking the Role of Tool Graph Memory in Multi-Turn Tool Use
papers.authors: Uiji Hwang, Richeng Xuan, Taeuk Kim
papers.evidence: 对多轮智能体工具调用中工具图记忆的实证再检验
papers.tldr: LLM智能体多轮调用工具完成复杂任务，已有工作用工具图记忆存储工具转移来指导选择，但其作用尚不明确。作者在九个模型、两个基准上系统评估该记忆机制，并与随机引导、无引导及文本经验存储对比。结果显示工具图记忆很少显著优于基线，即使有增益也需两倍以上LLM调用，且随机或无引导保留大部分收益。将经验存为文本洞察更优且几乎不增调用，表明记忆应作软先验而非下一步工具处方。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks by calling external tools over multiple turns. Recent work has proposed tool graph memory, which stores past experience as tool transitions to guide subsequent selection. However, it remains unclear whether this component consistently improves agents' tool use or undermines it. We evaluate tool graph memory on nine models and two benchmarks, finding that it seldom improves significantly over baselines, and that its gains, where present, cost over twice the LLM calls. The memory's guidance is often incorrect, and random or no guidance retains most of the gain, implying that the benefit stems from extra computation rather than the memory itself. Moreover, even with the correct next tool suggested, many failures remain, such as giving up without a tool call. Storing the same experience instead as textual insights outperforms tool graph memory with almost no extra LLM calls. This suggests that memory serves better as a soft prior than as a prescription of the next tool, leading to a more effective and generalizable solution.

papers.title_en: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.authors: Weihao Li, Jun Bai, Shijie Chen, Qincheng Lu, Xinyu Wang, Ziyang Song
papers.evidence: 基于本地与共享经验图的跨智能体经验迁移
papers.tldr: LLM智能体可复用历史经验提升后续任务表现，但不同智能体的执行历史与任务需求差异导致跨智能体经验难以有效复用。XferAgent将可复用经验组织为本地与共享经验图，协调异构智能体的兼容贡献并规避不可靠合并，再为新任务选取共享经验并与目标智能体本地经验融合。多领域实验显示其优于代表性记忆方法，并能实现异构框架间经验迁移，随着任务轮次推进累计成功率持续上升。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.

papers.title_en: XViewRank: Overlap-Conditioned Score Fusion for LLM-Augmented Sparse Retrieval
papers.authors: Xinxuan Lv, Minghan Li, Guodong Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向大模型增强查询视图的检索端分数融合方法
papers.tldr: LLM 生成假设与回退查询视图可缓解稀疏检索词汇不匹配，但多视图独立检索后结果互补、冗余或漂移，固定融合并非最优。XViewRank 对原始查询、假设视图和回退视图的 BM25 结果做条件化融合：每个候选保留三路归一化分数与三路结果集重叠度，由小型非线性打分器据此调节视图分数，无需联合编码查询与段落。在 TREC DL 2019/2020 匹配输入下，其 nDCG@10 与 MAP 数值优于 RRF，DL19 的 MAP 提升显著；低一致性时收益最明显，DL20 证据较弱。这表明重叠条件化分数融合可作为轻量检索端替代方案，并界定其优势范围。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can reduce vocabulary mismatch in sparse retrieval by generating alternative views of a query. Once these views are searched independently, however, their ranked lists may be complementary, redundant, or affected by query drift, making fixed fusion suboptimal. We present XViewRank, a lightweight retrieval-side method for conditionally fusing BM25 results from an original query, a hypothesis view, and a step-back view. For each pooled candidate, XViewRank retains three normalized BM25 scores and three query-level overlaps between the retrieved result sets. A small nonlinear scorer uses the overlaps as context that changes how the view-specific scores are interpreted, without jointly encoding query and passage text. Under a matched-input protocol, XViewRank improves nDCG@10 and MAP numerically over reciprocal rank fusion on both TREC DL 2019 and 2020, with a statistically significant MAP gain on DL19. Additional analyses show that the clearest benefit occurs when the view rankings have low agreement, while the evidence on DL20 is weaker. The results support overlap-conditioned score fusion as a compact retrieval-side alternative to fixed fusion, while also delimiting where its advantage is empirically established.

papers.title_en: Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval
papers.authors: Yingtao Luo, Kangyi Zhao, Shiyi Du, Yubo Li
papers.evidence: 面向高效文本检索的自适应推理深度
papers.tldr: 推理增强嵌入能提升检索，但额外推理会引入过度泛化或语义噪声，削弱检索针对性。AURA直接按中间推理状态区分相关文档与困难干扰项的能力进行监督，并用轻量效用估计器在推理时自适应决定推理深度。在BRIGHT上，AURA-4B取得34.7平均nDCG@10，每查询仅用2.8步推理和96个生成token；匹配部署下延迟从4.6秒降至0.76秒。这表明可按效用动态停止推理，在保持检索效果的同时显著提升效率。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

papers.title_en: Poisoning the Neighborhood: A Topology-Aware Topic-Level Attack on Large-Scale HNSW-based RAG Systems
papers.authors: Yufei Chen, Yao Wang, Haibin Zhang
papers.evidence: 针对大规模HNSW检索增强生成系统的拓扑感知投毒攻击
papers.tldr: RAG依赖外部知识但易受投毒，现有攻击假设精确检索，在HNSW近似检索下失效。本文提出面向大规模HNSW-RAG的拓扑感知主题级攻击，用Hub-Satellite结构组织毒文档，并结合实体-声明提升生成。在200万维基文档上检索成功率超72%、攻击成功率31.29%，显著优于基线。研究揭示图结构风险，并验证跨主题泛化能力，现有防御难以缓解。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations and knowledge staleness in large language models using external knowledge. However, ingestion from public and third-party sources exposes RAG systems to poisoning attacks. Existing attacks are designed and evaluated under exact retrieval, where poisoned documents participate in global ranking. Deployment-scale systems instead rely on approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) indexes such as hierarchical navigable small world (HNSW), where limited search budgets, graph-search reachability, and local benign-document competition invalidate this assumption and degrade existing attacks. We present a topology-aware topic-level poisoning attack against large-scale HNSW-RAG that generalizes to unseen topic queries. We organize poisoned documents into a Hub-Satellite structure: Satellites provide competitive entry points across semantic regions, while Hubs strengthen local cohesion and facilitate cascading retrieval. For generation, we propose an entity-claim promotion attack combining evidence anchoring and entity-claim coupling to promote the target entity via a target claim across different query regions. On 2M-document Wikipedia, our attack maintains over 72% retrieval success and reaches 31.29% attack success, substantially outperforming baselines; domain-specific experiments further support its effectiveness. Structural analyses show that the Hub-Satellite topology forms in HNSW, indicating that graph structure contributes to improved poisoned-document retrieval. Existing poisoning defenses cannot mitigate the attack, exposing graph-structural risks in HNSW-RAG systems.
